capabilities: Run Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode as local chat and inline-edit collaborators
Publish notes to WeChat, Feishu, Tencent Docs, Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, Bilibili, Toutiao, Weibo, Jike, and X via a browser extension
Convert articles into Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Jike, and X image or text posts
Share note snapshots to share.wesight.ai links with comment controls
Sync the vault with a GitHub repository with automatic pull and push
extras: Several features (Knowledge Brain, article-to-social conversion, browser handoff) require a paid WeSight membership; WeChat drafts consume credits. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff, and much of the in-app documentation is in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to drive local agent CLIs for AI chat or editing, and publishing notes to platforms like WeChat or Feishu requires manual copying and formatting.

relations.evidence: Run Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode as local AI collaborators inside an Obsidian vault.

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode CLI

summary: Runs Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode agent CLIs in the vault for sidebar chat and inline editing, and publishes notes to WeChat, Feishu, and social platforms.
